newsitem.title: USA: Novavax says FDA oks testosterone drug tests.
newsitem.headline: Novavax says FDA oks testosterone drug tests.

text.p: Novavax Inc Thursday said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration is allowing the company to begin human clinical testing of its topical testosterone product, Androsorb.
The company expects to begin its human clinical safety studies of Androsorb in the first quarter of 1997.
Androsorb is human testosterone encapsulated in Novavax's proprietary Micellar Nanoparticle cream. MNP creams are used for the transdermal delivery of alcohol-soluble drugs.

Androsorb is being developed as a replacement treatment for testosterone deficient males. Testosterone replacement therapy in men maintains muscle mass, increases energy and libido, and prevents osteoporosis, Novavax said.
Current forms of testosterone replacement therapy include intramuscular injections and a transdermal patch delivery system, they said.
